text: I hesitated for a long time whether to write a review, but I'm extremely disappointed with this dental clinic. Two years ago, I had two fillings done, but afterwards, the work felt sloppy. It looked chipped and scratched, but I thought that's probably how they do it now since I hadn't had dental work done in a long time. This year, I went back for three more fillings. Before the procedure, I could eat normally without any problems. But after, eating became painful. Two weeks later, the treated side is now sore, even though it never had a problem before. It's like they didn't put enough filling material in, causing pain when eating. Each filling cost 900 baht, plus another 900 baht for scaling, totaling 3600 baht. I won't be going back there again. I went because it's close to home. I'm truly disappointed. I'm even speculating that they might not have filled the painful tooth properly, but deliberately allowed it to decay so I'd have to come back again.

text: We went to consult about our 2-year-old child's tooth decay. The female doctor spoke very rudely, accusing us of neglecting our child's dental health and so on. While we were talking to the male doctor, we lured our child with toys that the shop had prepared for children to play with. But as we were talking to the male doctor and were about to end the conversation, saying goodbye because the youngest child was still there, she came up and snatched the toy out of our child's hand, causing him to fall to the floor, his head hitting the floor. We were very shocked. Why was she so concerned about the toy? She used such force that our child fell to the floor, crying very hard. She then said something like we were indulging her, like we were spoiling him, even brushing his teeth, and he was so peevish when he played with toys. Everyone would cry when he snatched things out of their hands while he was playing. It had nothing to do with our upbringing. She also said that if we didn't take care of our younger sibling's personality, our unborn child would end up like our older brother. That's very harsh.
author_name: นายตระการ ปราบพาล
